FN-U94UWGX-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 307
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/21/2025
Senate Bill 307 as introduced would require counties and municipalities to annually publish
certain financial information on official county and municipal websites, or certain other
websites if an official county or municipal website is not maintained. This could increase the
administrative obligations of the counties and municipalities not currently providing financial
information through online publication.

FN-U94UWGX-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 307
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Keith Kelley
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/22/2025
Senate Bill 307 as reported by the Committee on Fiscal Responsibility and Economic
Development would require counties and municipalities to: (1) annually publish certain
financial information on official county and municipal websites, or certain other websites until
an official website is created if an official county or municipal website is not maintained; or (2)
to post in certain county and municipal offices where such information may be found. This
would increase the obligations of the counties and municipalities not currently providing
financial information through online publication by an undetermined amount dependent upon
the costs to create and maintain an official website.
